g.text: Skeet Shoot 8088 computer on one sheet. Every connection is a drawn wire; the address and data buses are continuous bus lines across the middle (A[0..19], D[0..7]), each chip joining

g.desc: Skeet Shoot 8088 computer on one sheet. Every connection is a drawn wire; the address and data buses are continuous bus lines across the middle (A[0..19], D[0..7]), each chip joining

g.text: through bus entries (labels name the members). Top: clock, 8088, latches and buffers, 8253 timer + speaker, 8259 interrupts. Bottom: I/O decode, 8255, LED bar, display, switches; memory.

g.desc: through bus entries (labels name the members). Top: clock, 8088, latches and buffers, 8253 timer + speaker, 8259 interrupts. Bottom: I/O decode, 8255, LED bar, display, switches; memory.

g.text: CLOCK AND RESET (8284A, 12 MHz crystal, RC reset) ARE RECONSTRUCTED (2026): not in the 2007 drawings. IC power pins are implied (VCC/GND) as on the printed figures.

g.desc: CLOCK AND RESET (8284A, 12 MHz crystal, RC reset) ARE RECONSTRUCTED (2026): not in the 2007 drawings. IC power pins are implied (VCC/GND) as on the printed figures.
